column1: Units: Tk mn. Annual reports state Tk crore for most years; converted x10. Bank-only (solo) statements, not consolidated. Blue = hardcoded input, black = formula.

Sources by year: 1972-1996 AR2013 p.32 (deposits, loans, pre-tax profit); 2008 AR2013 pp.81-82 (rounded); 2009-2013 AR2013 five-year table & ratios (NPL/provision/EPS/2013 statements from AR2014 notes); 2014 AR2014 + AR2016/AR2018 five-year tables.

2015 from AR2016 comparatives (AR2015 not supplied - only the AGM notice); 2016 AR2016; 2017 AR2017; 2018 AR2018; 2019-2020 AR2022 five-year table (AR2019/AR2020 not supplied); 2021 AR2022 comparatives; 2022 AR2022; 2023 AR2023; 2024 AR2024; 2025 AR2025.

Gaps: 1997-2007 not in the supplied files (continuation of the AR2013 'Some indicators' table is missing from the scan). Net profit after tax exists only from 2009; earlier profit is pre-tax (row 32). EPS not available for 2009-2011, 2019-2020. NPL amount/provision not available for 2009-2011 and 2019 (provision also 2020).

Definitions: Loans = gross loans and advances per balance sheet. Non-interest income = investment income + commission, exchange & brokerage + other operating income. Shareholders' equity includes share money deposit. Own-year report used where supplied (e.g. 2023 total assets 793,302 vs 793,508 restated in AR2024).

NPL % (row 19) is a formula: NPL amount / gross loans, so it always ties to the audited note. Bank-printed ratios differ in some years (2012: 26.07%, 2013: 17.48%, 2016: 20.64%, 2017: 23.41%, 2018: 19.21% - different denominator) and 2021 (AR2025 shows 18.84%).

Provision Coverage % (row 21) = Provision Maintained (row 33, loans & advances, general + specific) / NPL amount. Cost-to-Income and CAR are as reported by the bank; where not printed they are computed from the same report's five-year table (see cell comments).
Cost-to-income is above 100% in 2016 (loss year). Net interest income is negative in 2014-2016 and from 2020 onwards (interest paid exceeds interest earned).
The older 'Rupali Bank' tab in this workbook shows figures (e.g. 2025 EPS 4.6, CAR 125%, NPL 5.3%) that do not match the audited annual reports; this tab supersedes it.
